rows.en: ...It's been a while, Diondra. You don't seem to be making much progress collecting the Data Weapons, do you?
rows.notes: Grujios greets Diondra and challenges her lack of Data Weapon collection progress. Final restores explicit question ending.

rows.en: I'd like to hear you say that after you've come out here yourself.
rows.notes: Diondra challenges Grujios to experience field conditions before criticizing her.

rows.en: Gades is furious. At this rate, your demotion is certain.
rows.notes: Grujios warns Diondra of Gades' anger and impending demotion; not past demotion.

rows.en: Hmph. Mind your own business.
rows.notes: Diondra dismisses Grujios' unsolicited warning.

rows.en: You've got some nerve, considering you nearly got demoted yourself.
rows.notes: Thought aside about Grujios' near-demotion; direct you avoids guessing Grujios' gender. Colloquial mockery.

rows.en: So, is it Rom's gang that's interfering with us Gyandlar?
rows.notes: Grujios asks whether Rom's party is obstructing Gyandlar.

rows.en: That's right. They followed us all the way out to this backwater planet...
rows.notes: Devil Saturn 6 confirms and complains about pursuit to Earth; unfinished source ending retained.

rows.en: They really don't know when to quit.
rows.notes: Continues complaint about Rom's persistent party.

rows.en: Speaking of that, that brat said something strange...
rows.notes: Diondra introduces Rom's strange assertion; brat insult preserved.
uncertain: The brat is inferred to be Rom from the surrounding exchange about his party and claim; not explicitly named in this row.

rows.en: Oh...? What did he say?
rows.notes: Grujios asks what Rom said; Rom is the boy in IDs8,10-12, male in glossary.
uncertain: Male pronoun relies on contextual inference that the brat is Rom, whose glossary gender is male.

rows.en: I don't know what that idiot got mixed up, but...
rows.notes: Devil Saturn 6 insults Rom and trails into following row; deliberate unfinished ending retained.

rows.en: He had the nerve to say he'd beaten us ages ago.
rows.notes: Rom allegedly claimed to have beaten Gyandlar long ago; insolent tone and past claim retained.

rows.en: Yes... He said he'd definitely defeated Gyandlar.
rows.notes: Diondra confirms Rom explicitly claimed to defeat Gyandlar.

rows.en: Hmm... That's a strange story. I'll report it to Gades, just in case.
rows.notes: Grujios finds the claim odd and will report it to Gades as a precaution.

rows.en: ...Speaking of strange, there's something I've been wondering about.
rows.notes: Diondra pivots from Rom's strange claim to her own concern.

rows.en: What is it?
rows.notes: Grujios asks Diondra to state the concern.

rows.en: Those Data Weapons Gades ordered us to search for...
rows.notes: Topic fragment introducing Data Weapons and Gades' search order; deliberate trailing ending retained.

rows.en: Does Gyandlar really need them?
rows.notes: Diondra questions whether Gyandlar needs Data Weapons at all.

rows.en: Why do you think that?
rows.notes: Grujios asks why Diondra doubts their necessity.

rows.en: I hear whoever gathers all the Data Weapons can become king of the universe, but...
rows.notes: Reported promise of universal kingship; but trails into objection at ID20.

rows.en: Even if we actually capture them, only Dendoh and Ogre can use them.
rows.notes: Diondra contrasts capture with usability; only Dendoh and Ogre can use Data Weapons.

rows.en: Isn't the Gulfer Emperor deceiving us?
rows.notes: Diondra suspects Gulfer Emperor is deceiving Gyandlar; questioning accusation.

rows.en: Searching for the Data Weapons is Gades' own wish, too.
rows.notes: Grujios says Gades himself also wants the search.

rows.en: You just need to cooperate with Gulfer and go after them.
rows.notes: Grujios orders Diondra's party to cooperate with Gulfer and pursue Data Weapons, not Rom. Data Weapons referent is settled by IDs22 and30 despite intervening Rom discussion.

rows.en: That doesn't sit right with me. Rom and his gang have us on the defensive...
rows.notes: Diondra resists; Rom's party forces Gyandlar into disadvantage, followed by ID25 grievance.

rows.en: Then the Hyribead activated and sent us to this backwater, and now we're supposed to help Gulfer on top of that.
rows.notes: Diondra lists displacement by Hyribead activation plus required cooperation with Gulfer; subject we restored.

rows.en: Heh heh heh... I suppose it's only natural you'd feel that way.
rows.notes: Grujios concedes her reaction is natural while knowing a concealed motive.

rows.en: What? What do you mean?
rows.notes: Diondra presses Grujios to explain his knowing remark.

rows.en: ...This planet called Earth is an even greater treasure trove than Planet Cronos. That's all I'll tell you for now.
rows.notes: Grujios hints Earth's riches exceed Planet Cronos but withholds more information.

rows.en: A treasure trove...?
rows.notes: Echo question retaining source fragment; Diondra reacts to treasure trove.

rows.en: Anyway, you are to go after the Data Weapons. Understood?
rows.notes: Grujios closes inquiry with explicit order to pursue Data Weapons.

rows.en: ...We're heading out, Devil Saturn 6. Hurry up and get ready.
rows.notes: Diondra orders Devil Saturn 6 to prepare for departure.

rows.en: Huh!? W-where are we going?
rows.notes: Devil Saturn 6 is surprised and stammers asking destination.

rows.en: We're going somewhere the Data Weapons are likely to turn up.
rows.notes: Diondra names likely Data Weapon locations as destination; subject/action restored.

rows.en: But do you have any idea where that would be?
rows.notes: Devil Saturn 6 asks whether Diondra has a concrete destination lead.

rows.en: We'll head down to Earth for now. After that... it's a gamble.
rows.notes: Diondra plans descent to Earth, then admits the search is a gamble.

rows.en: ...Harry, what did you need me for?
rows.notes: Scene changes to Nadesico communication; source nickname Harry in body, Hari prefill retained.

rows.en: Oh, Koji. Professor Yumi at the Photon Power Laboratory is calling you.
rows.notes: Hari reports Professor Yumi's incoming call from Photon Power Laboratory to Koji.

rows.en: The professor? Then put him through.
rows.notes: Koji asks Hari to connect Professor Yumi; sourced male professor pronoun.

rows.en: Yes.
rows.notes: Hari acknowledges connecting the call.

rows.en: ...I'm sorry I had to call you away, Koji.
rows.notes: Professor Yumi apologizes to Koji for calling him away.

rows.en: It's fine. So, what did you need?
rows.notes: Koji accepts apology and asks purpose of call.

rows.en: Well, I'd like you to come back to the laboratory for a visit.
rows.notes: Professor Yumi asks Koji to return to the lab; request direction preserved.

rows.en: Why is that?
rows.notes: Koji asks why he should return.

rows.en: Considering what's ahead, we should use our facilities here to give Mazinger Z a thorough inspection while we have the chance.
rows.notes: Yumi recommends full Mazinger Z inspection with laboratory equipment now, in view of future needs.

rows.en: I see...
rows.notes: Koji acknowledges Yumi's reasoning with trailing reflection.

rows.en: Besides, some of its weapons were removed when it was put in the museum...
rows.notes: Yumi notes weapons removed for museum storage; passive avoids guessing who physically removed them.

rows.en: I'd like to take this opportunity to restore Mazinger Z to its original state. What do you think?
rows.notes: Yumi proposes restoration to original condition and asks Koji's agreement.

rows.en: Understood, Professor. I'll be right there.
rows.notes: Koji agrees and says he will come immediately.

rows.en: Then be very careful out there.
rows.notes: Yumi tells Koji to be especially careful during his trip. Final preserves emphatic caution more directly.

rows.en: ...So that's the story. I'm heading out for a bit!
rows.notes: Koji tells bridge crew he is setting out briefly; subject/action restored.

rows.en: Ah! Koji!
rows.notes: Hari tries to stop Koji with attention call; source vocative fragment retained.

rows.en: He's gone...
rows.notes: Hari observes Koji has already left; subject restored using glossary male Koji.

rows.en: I wonder if Koji will be all right...
rows.notes: Eris worries about Koji's safety, clarified by past capture in ID55.

rows.en: What do you mean?
rows.notes: Hari asks why Eris is worried.

rows.en: He went out alone once before and ended up getting captured by the Vegan Empire.
rows.notes: Eris recounts Koji's prior solo departure and capture by Vegan Empire; male referent glossary-backed.

rows.en: What!? Th-this is bad, Captain!
rows.notes: Hari reacts to Eris's report of Koji's previous capture; addresses Ruri as Captain. Stutter preserved.

rows.en: It'll be all right. The others will probably go with him.
rows.notes: Ruri reassures Hari; restored Koji as him, settled by 48-55 and sourced male profile.

rows.en: At least four of them... Or maybe five?
rows.notes: Saburota counts companions for Koji; comic correction four to five preserved. Retained intentional numerical-answer fragment; counting predicate comes from 57.

rows.en: Five...? You mean Sayaka, Boss, Nuke and Mucha, right?
rows.notes: Eris counts four named companions and questions the fifth; source-short names retained. Opening Five...? is an intentional echoed-count fragment.

rows.en: Who's the fifth person? Tetsuya, or maybe Daisuke?
rows.notes: Hari proposes Tetsuya or Daisuke as the fifth; source-short forms retained.

rows.en: Well now, who could it be?
rows.notes: Saburota knowingly teases Hari; withheld identity resolves as Maria at the lab.
Retained source question-mark-only reaction, intentional fragment.

rows.en: ...Dr. Gura, how are preparations for the operation to conquer the surface progressing?
rows.notes: Scene switches to Burai questioning Dr. Gura about invasion preparations.

rows.en: We're producing Hyakki mechs and Hyakki soldiers at a rapid pace, but...
rows.notes: Dr. Gura reports accelerated production to Burai; retained trailing but, continuing into 65. Central descriptive class terms confirmed: Hyakki mechs and Hyakki soldiers.

rows.en: I believe it will take a little more time to reach the planned numbers.
rows.notes: Completes 64 production report; planned quantity is the target, not an immediate deadline.

rows.en: Then, Hidler, report on the current situation on the surface.
rows.notes: Burai turns to Hidler and orders a surface status report.

rows.en: There is a lull at present... Skirmishes between the Federation forces and Giganos continue...
rows.notes: Hidler reports lull and continuing skirmishes; retained source trailing continuation into 68.

rows.en: Neither Mu nor Tekkoryu has made any notable moves.
rows.notes: Completes force-status report. Central source review confirms glossary parenthetical Iron Dragon is explanatory, not spoken; source-only Tekkoryu retained. Meaning correction, not fit compression.

rows.en: Then what is the situation in space?
rows.notes: Burai asks Hidler for space status; restored situation predicate.

rows.en: Those calling themselves the Martian Successors have risen in rebellion, but have made no concrete move since.
rows.notes: Hidler reports the rebellion and absence of a concrete subsequent move; not absence of rebellion.

rows.en: Those alien scum are in the same position.
rows.notes: Hidler adds aliens also have not acted; contempt retained in scum.

rows.en: I see...
rows.notes: Burai acknowledges report.

rows.en: Emperor Burai, I believe now is the perfect opportunity for our Hyakki Empire to conquer the surface.
rows.notes: Hidler recommends immediate conquest to Emperor Burai; our Hyakki Empire restored.

rows.en: Do not be hasty, Hidler. In this war... whoever judges the times will win in the end. Thus, we must first build up our strength now.
rows.notes: Burai rejects haste, explains judging the times and prioritizes strength; no claim that invasion is abandoned. Measured four-line initial overflow compressed by tightening triumph/priority phrasing, preserving all propositions.

rows.en: Yes, sir.
rows.notes: Hidler formally acknowledges order. Conventional acknowledgment kept as an intentional short response.

rows.en: And to make my Hyakki Fortress Island even more formidable...
rows.notes: Retained deliberate trailing conditional goal into 77; my Fortress Island preserves possessive.

rows.en: We need the Getter Ray amplifier, the Photon Power reactor, and Zeorymer.
rows.notes: Completes 76: required targets are all three technologies/unit, not alternatives. Central descriptive term Photon Power reactor confirmed.

rows.en: Yes, sir! Next time, I will surely...!
rows.notes: Retained source promise trailing off; supplied I will for Hidler's commitment to acquire targets.

rows.en: Then sortie. While those on the surface glare at one another, you will obtain what I desire.
rows.notes: Burai orders Hidler to sortie and seize desired targets during other factions' standoff.

rows.en: Hyakki, Buraaaaai!
rows.notes: Preserved sourced salute Hyakki, Buraaaai with source shout elongation; not an attack name.

rows.en: I'm home, Father!
rows.notes: Scene returns to laboratory; Sayaka greets her father.

rows.en: Oh, Sayaka. So you came along too?
rows.notes: Professor Yumi learns Sayaka accompanied Koji.

rows.en: Yes, I'm here as Koji's bodyguard.
rows.notes: Sayaka teases Koji as his bodyguard; restored I am.

rows.en: If we let him go alone, the enemy might grab him again.
rows.notes: Mucha recalls capture story from 55; we let him go and Koji pronoun restored.

rows.en: Please, give me a break and stop bringing that up.
rows.notes: Koji asks companions to stop teasing him about capture; request direction preserved.

rows.en: Anyway, Boss... It'sh been a long time shince we came here.
rows.notes: Nuke addresses Boss; source speech quirk represented by light sh spelling.

rows.en: Yeah. After Kabuto went to study in America, we went over to Tetsuya and the others' place.
rows.notes: Boss explains the gang's move after Kabuto went abroad; surname-only body form preserved; restored we.

rows.en: Oh, so that's how it was.
rows.notes: Maria reacts to Boss's history; restored that is how it was.

rows.en: And who are you?
rows.notes: Professor Yumi asks Maria's identity; restored who are you predicate.

rows.en: Nice to meet you. I'm Grace Maria Fleed.
rows.notes: Maria formally introduces herself; source full name stays Grace Maria Fleed.

rows.en: Fleed... Then you're Daisuke Umon's younger sister, aren't you?
rows.notes: Professor Yumi identifies Maria as Daisuke Umon's younger sister; full source name preserved.

rows.en: Yes.
rows.notes: Maria confirms the relationship. Conventional acknowledgment kept as an intentional short response.

rows.en: Anyway, I don't remember inviting you here, do I?
rows.notes: Sayaka confronts Maria over invitation; personal I restored.

rows.en: But I wanted to see where Koji used to live.
rows.notes: Maria gives her reason for accompanying Koji; I wanted restored.

rows.en: Huh? Why did you want to see it?
rows.notes: Koji questions Maria's stated wish to visit; restored wanted to see it.

rows.en: Why...? Because I'm interested, of course!
rows.notes: Maria answers Koji's why with personal interest; I am restored.

rows.en: Besides, I'm not letting you and Sayaka be alone together.
rows.notes: Maria declares she will prevent Koji and Sayaka being alone; refers directly to Koji as you.

rows.en: I-I wasn't planning anything like that!
rows.notes: Sayaka stammeringly denies romantic intent, answering 97.

rows.en: Oh, really? Your intentions are plain as day.
rows.notes: Maria calls Sayaka's motive obvious; teasing rhetorical doubt retained.

rows.en: What's that supposed to mean!?
rows.notes: Sayaka angrily challenges Maria's insinuation.

rows.en: Hey, hey, stop fighting.
rows.notes: Koji tells Maria and Sayaka to stop arguing; imperative is appropriate.

rows.en: What's wrong with showing Maria around the lab? It's not like it'll lose anything.
rows.notes: Koji misses jealousy and defends showing Maria the laboratory; nothing is lost idiom retained.

rows.en: Oh, honestly! Koji, you idiot!!
rows.notes: Sayaka insults Koji directly; strength and doubled exclamation retained.

rows.en: H-hey, Sayaka...
rows.notes: Professor Yumi attempts to call Sayaka back; source unfinished address retained.

rows.en: Huh? Sayaka, why are you so angry?
rows.notes: Koji directly asks Sayaka why she is angry; no third-person invented listener.

rows.en: Koji's pretty clueless for not noticing that... But it looks like I still have a chance.
rows.notes: Actual thought row. Maria recognizes Koji's obliviousness; chance is Maria's romantic prospects, settled by 93-105. Supplied I; no guessed gender.
uncertain: Interpreted remaining chance as Maria's romantic chance with Koji, supported by the jealousy exchange.

rows.en: Hmmm...
rows.notes: Retained wordless source grumble as Hmmm...

rows.en: Ah, Boss... You're jealous of Kabuto, aren't you?
rows.notes: Nuke teases Boss about envying Kabuto; surname-only form preserved.

rows.en: Shut up! I haven't thought anything like that, not even a little!
rows.notes: Boss emphatically denies jealousy; insult and not even a little retained.

rows.en: Oh, come on, you're trying too hard. It's written all over your face.
rows.notes: Mucha exposes Boss's strained denial; face idiom and you restored.

rows.en: ...Anyway, Koji. I'd like to get started on the work right away.
rows.notes: Professor Yumi redirects conversation to work, addressing Koji; I would like restored.

rows.en: Understood. I'll help too.
rows.notes: Koji agrees to help Professor Yumi; I will and too restored.

rows.en: Me! Number one in the Commander Ranking! Beaten?!
uncertain: Source is a defeat cry with no verb ('This me, No. 1 in the Commander Ranking...!'); 'Beaten?!' supplied from the context of a defeat line. 'Commander Ranking' from glossary term [jp].

rows.en: Nuuuoooh! Me... How could I, of all people...?!
uncertain: Source is a bare 'Me... this me?!' defeat cry; 'How could I' supplies the implied disbelief.

rows.en: Rom!!
Mark my words! I shall return!
uncertain: [jp] is English in katakana; rendered as plain English.

rows.en: Lord Gades, I served you faithfully! Why won't you come to save me?!
uncertain: [jp] rendered 'Lord Gades'; assumed the line is addressed to Gades (rescue plea).

rows.en: Ah, no! My Commander Ranking's gonna drop!
uncertain: Kansai-dialect comic line ('[jp]'); dialect conveyed only through casual register.

rows.en: Milady! Master Rom! I am terribly sorry!
uncertain: [jp] = Leina (Jim is Leina's servant) -> 'Milady'; [jp] -> 'Master Rom'.

rows.en: What has justice ever done for me? Justice does nothing for anyone...
uncertain: [jp] object not stated; 'for me' / 'for anyone' chosen.

rows.en: Pass this on! Tell them I fought a battle no martial artist would be ashamed of!
uncertain: [jp] has no stated recipient; kept unnamed ('Tell them'). Likely meant for Rom, not asserted.

rows.en: Brother Rom! I'm sorry!
Wh-wh-whoa! Rooom~!
I'm counting on you to carry on!
uncertain: [jp]: Rom asks the listener (his allies) to take over; listener not named.

rows.en: Unable to continue combat...
They got me?! No way!!
uncertain: [jp] has no subject; 'They got me' (agent unspecified).

rows.en: Ah... Aaah?!
N-no way... Is this as far as I go...?!
Y-you're kidding! Me, of all people?! I can't believe it!
Ugh! I can't be like this... I just can't let it end like this!
uncertain: [jp]: the 'I' is inferred (Asuka berating herself).

rows.en: Yes... That's how it should be......

uncertain: speaker_en was empty; filled from glossary [jp] = 'Mass-produced EVA'.

rows.en: I'll leave your fate be... for now!
uncertain: [jp] (retreat line): 'I'll hold off on your fate for a while'.

rows.en: Careless of me... Is this the end...?!
Damn, is this as far as I go?!
No...! It can't be, not this!!

uncertain: speaker_en was empty; [jp] speaker filled as 'Gulfer' (glossary term [jp], do_not_touch). Probably the generic Gulfer soldier unit ([jp] = 'Gulfer Soldier'); kept the shorter in-game label.

rows.en: O-Oyakata-samaaa!
uncertain: [jp] kept as 'Oyakata-sama' per glossary term.

rows.en: Wh-what?! Impossible!!
Th-this can't... This is absurd...!!
It's no good! I have to bail out!
uncertain: [jp] has no subject; 'I' inferred (Kirakuni flies the Cell Fighter; not verified that it is solo).

rows.en: We have to... bail out...!
uncertain: [jp] has no subject; 'We' inferred because Dendoh is co-piloted by Ginga and Hokuto. This line is reused in 3 places (s00r00:32/33/173) and may play when Hokuto is in another unit - check.

rows.en: Is this the end...?!
Nuooooooh!!
It seems retreat is my only choice...!
uncertain: [jp]: subject inferred as 'my' (Vega speaking for herself); could be 'our' if she leads a group.

rows.en: Your Majesty, Gulfer Emperor... Please... forgive me...
uncertain: [jp] -> 'Your Majesty, Gulfer Emperor' using glossary 'Gulfer Emperor' (note: glossary en_short for that entry is 'Galfa Emperor', inconsistent with en_full/do_not_touch 'Gulfer').

rows.en: B-bailing out~! Ryoko, don't get mad at me, okay?!
uncertain: [jp] has no subject; rendered as 'bailing out' (Hikaru herself).

rows.en: Curses...! Hurry, all hands, evacuate!
Dammit! Is this how it ends?!
Wha! This is as far as I go?! How pathetic...!
uncertain: [jp] / [jp]: subject 'I' inferred (Saburota about himself).

rows.en: Yu... Yurika......
In death, none shall gather my bones... To perish is my fate...
uncertain: [jp] is a stock oath phrase ('none will gather the corpse of the fallen'); rendered with 'my' since he is speaking of himself.

rows.en: Omoikane... I'm sorry. All hands, abandon ship!
This is the end... and that's a wrap...
uncertain: [jp] ('end of the scroll' = 'it's all over'); Izumi is a punster, 'that's a wrap' keeps the media idiom.

rows.en: Ngh! Next time, victory will be ours!
Uwaah! Captain, sir!!
uncertain: [jp] = Meio (captain) -> 'Captain, sir'.

rows.en: Dammit, you'll pay for this! You Dragonar scum!!
uncertain: [jp] rendered 'you'll pay for this' (stock threat).

rows.en: Uoooooh?!
D-dammiiiit!!
Take care of my mom for me...!!
uncertain: [jp]: Kaine asks the listener (unnamed) to look after his mother; direction kept as a request.

rows.en: C-Colonel!!
uncertain: [jp] = Gon Jem (colonel).

rows.en: What?! Waaaah!!
It's no good! I'm bailing out!!
C-Captain, sirrr!
uncertain: [jp] = Meio.

rows.en: As long as I live, the Giganos Empire shall never fall...!
uncertain: [jp] literally 'as long as I am here'; 'as long as I live' chosen.

rows.en: Heh, so this is as far as I go...
Tch, that's all for today!
uncertain: [jp]: impersonal 'that's all for today' kept (Min retreating).

rows.en: Sorry! This is as far as I go!
Am I going down...?!
Ngh, how could this...
uncertain: [jp]… trails off in the source; kept the omission.

rows.en: Ah, no...!
Waaaah!! I-it's no good~
Judau! They got me!
No no no no!
Dammit! Sorry, I'm bailing out!
D-damn! They got me!
This is... the end...
N-no good! I've been hit!
Big brother...!
uncertain: Leina's brother is Judau; kept as 'Big brother' rather than naming him, matching the source.

rows.en: Aah, why did this happen to me of all people!?
uncertain: Source is the fragment 'why this me!?' (nande kono atashi ga); restored a verb ('happen to me').

rows.en: No good! I'm bailing out!
My unit's already done for!? Amuro...!
uncertain: Source 'mou kitai ga!?' omits the predicate; inferred 'already done for' (unit destroyed).

rows.en: So this is it... All hands, evacuate!
I... I lost...!
uncertain: Source 'maketa no ka' has no subject; restored 'I' (Argo about himself).

rows.en: Ugh! D-Domon!!
Hahaha... It's no use! You have no chance of winning...
You lot are finished no matter whaaat!
Splendid... Gwaaah!!
Ugh... ugh... I... I lost...!
uncertain: speaker_en was empty; filled 'Sai Saici' from glossary (speaker_jp is the short form 'Saishi').

rows.en: Ugh, guh, ah, aaaagh!
Alas... My fate, too, ends here...
Jeeesus! You gotta be kidding me!
Graaaaaah!!
Brrrrrr...
uncertain: Horse noise (Fuunsaiki); kept as 'Brrrrrr...'.

rows.en: Waaaaagh!
D-Domooon!!
You'd better remember this, you bastard!
Wh-whoa-whoaaa~
uncertain: Boss's comic exclamation 'arryaryaaan' has no fixed English; rendered as a goofy 'Wh-whoa-whoaaa~'.

rows.en: Noooo~! Koji~!
Daaamn iiit!
I'm bailing out!
Oh, come on. Whoa!?
Oh well. I'm counting on you for the rest, everyone.
uncertain: Direction: 'ato wa tanomu ze, minna' = Hayato asking everyone to handle the rest.

rows.en: Kyaaaah! Ryo! Hayato! Benkei!
rows.notes: Source nickname maps to Ryo per campaign_terms.json and https://srw.wiki.cre.jp/wiki/流竜馬; full [jp] remains Ryoma.
uncertain: Source says 'Ryou-kun' (nickname for Ryoma). No glossary entry for the nickname; used glossary short name 'Ryoma'. Could be 'Ryo' if the project prefers nicknames. Honorific -kun dropped.

rows.en: Don't think this means you've won!
E-Emperor Burai!
Getter's power is... Dammit!
uncertain: Kept the source's cut-off: 'Getter's power is...' (predicate omitted in JP, deliberately unfinished).

rows.en: J-Juniooor~!
uncertain: Zuril cries out 'Junior'; glossary has the unit 'Zuril Jr.'. Referent inferred to be his Zuril Jr.; kept as 'Junior' since that is what he shouts.

rows.en: King Vegaaaa!
uncertain: 'Vega Daiou-sama': honorific -sama not rendered separately; 'King' carries it.

rows.en: I am the king of the universe, King Vegaaa!
Kyaaaah! Kojiii!!
Kyaaaah!
Damn, I got careless! Me, of all people!
U-urgh... Jigajiga... Is this as far as we go...!
uncertain: 'Jigajiga' = his Vega Beast (glossary: Vega Beast Jigajiga). Restored subject 'we' (Mors + Jigajiga).

rows.en: I'm counting on you all to protect the Earth!
uncertain: Direction: Duke asking the others (kimitachi de) to protect Earth.

rows.en: Kyaaah!! Daisuke!
uncertain: Honorific -san dropped.

rows.en: Ooooh! Ugwaaaaaagh~!
I'm sorry... Miku...
Nuooooooh!!
No way! Zeorymer is going down!?
uncertain: Source 'masaka, Zeorymer ga!?' omits the predicate; inferred 'is going down' (unit-destroyed line).

rows.en: No way! Zeorymer is going down!?
uncertain: Same line as 363 (Masaki instead of Masato); same inferred predicate.

rows.en: Impossible...! Omzack... my "Lightning"!
uncertain: Glossary unit is 'Omzack of the Lightning' (character entry for Saiga says 'Thunder'); used 'Lightning' to match the unit name.

rows.en: Tau... I'm sorry... I... you...!
uncertain: speaker_en empty; filled 'Shi-Aen' from glossary (speaker_jp is short 'Aen'; glossary only has the full form). Kept source omission 'watashi wa... anata wo...!' (no verb); the intended verb is not settled out of context. 'Tau' used bare as in source; glossary full name Shi-Tau.

rows.en: Big sister...
uncertain: speaker_en empty; filled 'Shi-Tau' from glossary (speaker_jp is short 'Tau').

rows.en: Y-Yuratei...
...I was careless... I... have lost...
Saiga... I... end here...
uncertain: Source 'watashi wa... koko de...' omits the verb; inferred 'end here' (dying/defeat).

rows.en: Damn... A lifelong disgrace for Kyoshiro Yuzuki!
Damn!! It's no good!
Ugh! I've been hit!?
Kyaaaah!!
Not yet! Raideen! Whoa!
This... can't be...!
Damn, it's no good!!
Waaaaaah!!
Eek!! No...!! It can't be!!
Ah! Is this the end!?

rows.en: But some of them even turned into planes and cars!
rows.notes: Some party members transform; no gender is inferred.

rows.en: I'd say they were machines more than people.
rows.notes: Context-settled spoken response; no unresolved referent.

rows.en: Yeah, exactly. They seemed more like mobile suits or something.
rows.notes: Context-settled spoken response; no unresolved referent.

rows.en: Maybe they're mechanical life forms, like the Gulfer...
rows.notes: Mechanical life-form hypothesis stays tentative.

rows.en: I've been thinking this for ages... Those people just defy common sense.
rows.notes: Asuka refers to Rom and the Cronos group; sustained incredulous tone.

rows.en: Their robots appear out of nowhere, and some of them speak with Kansai accents even though they're from space...
rows.notes: Two specific complaints retained: appearing robots and Kansai dialect despite alien origin.

rows.en: People call that a freak show. The Gundam Fighters were more than enough of that sort already.
rows.notes: Asuka imitates Rom's People call that formula and insults the Gundam Fighters.
uncertain: Freak show renders derogatory iromono and imitates Rom's People call that formula.

rows.en: What?! What's that supposed to mean?!
rows.notes: Context-settled spoken response; no unresolved referent.

rows.en: If suddenly glowing gold in the middle of a fight isn't a freak show, then what is?!
rows.notes: Asuka defends her freak-show insult by citing the gold glow in combat.

rows.en: Shut up! Your robot's weird too!
rows.notes: Context-settled spoken response; no unresolved referent.

rows.en: Your robot drags that cable around like a goldfish trailing poop!
rows.notes: Explicit robot subject restored; crude literal goldfish-poop analogy retained.

rows.en: W-what did you say?!
rows.notes: Context-settled spoken response; no unresolved referent.

rows.en: ...Anyway, the Gulfer and Gyandlar will keep relentlessly pursuing the Data Weapons.
rows.notes: Daisuke redirects the group from squabbling to the persistent Data Weapon threat.

rows.en: And the Hyakki Empire has started moving again in search of energy...
rows.notes: Hyakki Empire energy motive retained.

rows.en: We have to find the rest of the Data Weapons as soon as possible.
rows.notes: Context-settled spoken response; no unresolved referent.

rows.en: Yes...!
rows.notes: Context-settled spoken response; no unresolved referent.

rows.en: I see... So it's a Data Weapon tracking program.
rows.notes: Ruri addresses Eris about the tracking program.

rows.en: Yes. We've run into all sorts of problems, so development has fallen behind...
rows.notes: Context-settled spoken response; no unresolved referent.

rows.en: Data Weapons respond to some kind of energy...
rows.notes: Eris begins the explanation continued by 314; ellipsis retained.

rows.en: ...and appear at its source. The program takes advantage of that.
rows.notes: Completes the sentence begun in313: Data Weapons respond to energy and appear at its source. The tracking program exploits that property. Deliberate initial continuation fragment preserves source sentence boundary.

rows.en: Then all we need to do is find out what that energy is, correct?
rows.notes: Context-settled spoken response; no unresolved referent.

rows.en: Yes. I've been running searches all this time, but I just can't narrow it down...
rows.notes: Eris has searched for the energy identity; it is that identity she cannot narrow down.

rows.en: I see... Then let's have Omoikane help us too.
rows.notes: Ruri offers Omoikane's assistance to Eris.

rows.en: Huh...? Is that really all right?
rows.notes: Context-settled spoken response; no unresolved referent.

rows.en: It's fine as long as we're not in combat. Finding the Data Weapons is one of our important missions, after all.
rows.notes: Ruri authorizes computer help outside combat and states the mission reason.

rows.en: Yes, thank you very much!
rows.notes: Context-settled spoken response; no unresolved referent.

rows.en: Captain, the Nahel Argama reports that it's ready to launch.
rows.notes: Hari speaker prefill preserved; report concerns Nahel Argama launch readiness.

rows.en: Then launch the Nadesico as well. We'll continue our patrol duties in the Japan area.
rows.notes: Ruri orders Nadesico launch and continued Japan-area patrol.

rows.en: About Gatling Boar... Why didn't you tell me at once?
rows.notes: Altair addresses Diondra about failing to report Gatling Boar promptly.

rows.en: I heard you were operating on your own, so I was being considerate.
rows.notes: Diondra claims consideration for Altair's solo operation.

rows.en: Hmph... Even if you people do get your hands on the Data Weapons...
rows.notes: Conditional sentence deliberately continues into 326.

rows.en: You do understand that only Dendoh and Ogre can use them... don't you?
rows.notes: Continuation of 325; only Dendoh and Ogre can use Data Weapons. Short source unit names retained.

rows.en: Yes, you don't have to tell me that.
rows.notes: Context-settled spoken response; no unresolved referent.

rows.en: Then I'd ask you to keep your meddling to yourself. You'll only get in the way of my mission.
rows.notes: Altair tells Diondra to refrain from interfering, because it obstructs his mission.

rows.en: That knife-mask guy really is an obnoxious bastard.
rows.notes: Knife-mask is Devil Saturn 6's mocking description of Altair, not a new identity. Crude force retained.

rows.en: Let him talk. More importantly, something you said made me realize something crucial.
rows.notes: Diondra responds to current complaint but refers back to earlier bait comment.

rows.en: Something I said? Did calling him knife-mask give you some sort of clue?
rows.notes: Devil Saturn 6 mistakenly assumes knife-mask wording prompted the insight.

rows.en: No, you idiot. I meant the word 'bait'.
rows.notes: Corrects 331: bait callback is s0420:245 and Diondra's reactions at246/248.

rows.en: Bait?
rows.notes: Intentional echo-question fragment, not an omitted subject needing restoration.

rows.en: Yes... Thanks to that, I understand why Gades sent us here.
rows.notes: Diondra has resolved the reason Gades sent them to Earth.

rows.en: W-why's that, then?
rows.notes: Devil Saturn 6 asks for the reason, with source stutter.

rows.en: The Data Weapons seek something besides Dendoh...
rows.notes: Diondra names Data Weapons as seekers, not objects pursued by some unnamed party.

rows.en: In other words, high energy that could be called their bait...
rows.notes: Deliberate explanatory fragment continues into338. Stray closing Japanese wrapper ignored per brief.
uncertain: bait also carries literal food sense; retained consistently with earlier Devil Saturn 6 wording.

rows.en: That's the new 'Hyribead' Gades is looking for.
rows.notes: High energy in337 is new Hyribead sought by Gades; quoted term retained.
